raw_response: {"diagnosis":"The silver_transactions filter `ingest_ts - txn_ts <= 26 HOUR` silently drops POSTED transactions that arrive about 3 days after txn_ts, which is what happens from batch 3 onward. txn_id is unique across raw, so the late rows are not duplicates. The fix removes the lateness filter and keeps the POSTED filter.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.7,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
